import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("cohort.csv")
df = df.dropna(subset=["bcaas", "t2d_event", "homa_ir"])
df["central_obesity"] = df["waist_cm"] >= 90

import numpy as np

x = df[["bcaas", "age", "sex", "homa_ir"]].to_numpy()
y = df["t2d_event"].to_numpy()
x = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x])

from scipy import stats

case = df.loc[df["t2d_event"] == 1, "bcaas"]
control = df.loc[df["t2d_event"] == 0, "bcaas"]
t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(case, control, nan_policy="omit")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

summary = df.groupby("bcaas_quartile")["t2d_event"].mean()
summary.plot(kind="bar")
plt.ylabel("T2D incidence")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("results/bcaa_t2d_incidence.png")

import json
from dataclasses import asdict

report = {"model": "BCAA + covariates", "p_value": float(p_value)}
with open("results/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
